description: First-party MCP server exposing Ahmed Rehan's portfolio, projects, case studies, services, certifications, and contact data as read-only tools.
instructions: Read-only portfolio data queries. All tools return JSON. Use get_portfolio_overview for a summary, list_upwork_portfolio for the recorded freelance work trail, get_contact_info for reach channels.

tools.name: get_portfolio_overview
tools.description: High-level summary of Ahmed Rehan: role, experience, focus areas, portfolio size, and availability surface.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services Ahmed offers (developer tools, webhook debugging/automation, agentic systems and tooling).

tools.name: list_featured_projects
tools.description: List featured and additional open-source projects with descriptions, highlights, and repository links.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: List detailed case studies (context, problem, approach, outcome, tech stack, metrics).

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: List professional capabilities and specialization areas.

tools.name: list_certifications
tools.description: List verifiable certifications with verification links.

tools.name: list_upwork_portfolio
tools.description: List recorded Upwork portfolio items (title, completion date, skills, description, project link).

tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.description: Get contact channels (email, WhatsApp) and profile links for reaching Ahmed.

tools.name: list_resume_downloads
tools.description: List downloadable resume PDFs with their labels and paths.

tools.name: list_writing_and_feeds
tools.description: List published articles and content feed sources.
